title: Agent providers
subtitle: Choose, detect, install, and update native agent CLIs.

settings.start-command-description: Use a command or shell alias available in the selected environment.
settings.release-retry: Refresh to try the release check again.
settings.update-warning: Lumora will run a global npm update. If {provider} was installed another way, this may create a separate installation.
settings.start-command-help: Provider layer override. Leave blank to use the detected executable.
settings.enabled-description: Choose which providers Lumora scans and displays. Disabling one never removes its CLI, settings, or saved session data.
settings.registry-description-local: Lumora reads the effective PATH and checks public release metadata. It only modifies a provider after you explicitly confirm an action.
settings.registry-description-remote: Lumora reads the remote effective PATH and checks public release metadata. It only modifies a provider after you explicitly confirm an action.
settings.scan-failed: The scan could not be completed. Refresh to try again.
settings.commands-load-error: Provider start commands could not be loaded.
settings.command-save-error: The provider start command could not be saved.
settings.update-error: {provider} could not be updated. Run {command} update manually or try again.
settings.update-cancelled: The {provider} update was cancelled. Check its version below before trying again.
settings.update-busy: {provider} is running, so its files could not be replaced. Close running {provider} sessions and try again.
settings.install-error: {provider} could not be installed. Open its installation guide or try again.
settings.guide-error: {provider}'s installation guide could not be opened.
settings.unified-description: Lumora uses the structured provider interface only after a successful capability check. Any unavailable or failed integration falls back to the native terminal automatically.
settings.unified-details-description: Review provider interface checks, choose providers individually, and inspect fallback guidance.
settings.unified-timed-out: Check timed out · Native terminal fallback
settings.use-unified: Use unified interface for {provider} when verified
settings.unified-error: Lumora could not check the structured provider interfaces. Native terminal fallback remains available.

environment.title: Developer environment
environment.subtitle: Basic tools used by supported agent providers.
environment.tools-description: Lumora checks the external Node.js and npm available on PATH.
environment.download-error: The Node.js download page could not be opened.
environment.version-failed: The executable was found, but its version check failed.
environment.check-unavailable-description: Lumora could not check Node.js or npm. Existing features remain available.
environment.missing-both: Node.js and npm were not found.
environment.unverified-one: {tool} was found, but its version could not be verified.
environment.unverified-both: Node.js and npm were found, but their versions could not be verified.
environment.mixed-attention: {missing} was not found, and {unverified} could not be verified.
environment.attention-description: Install or repair Node.js for the basic tooling used by many AI agent CLIs. Lumora will not install it for you.
environment.verify-command: Run {command} --version in a terminal, then refresh.
environment.retry: Refresh to check Node.js and npm again.
